title: Aonic Club Launches AI Membership to Sell Supplements at Cost
summary:
Max Meier has opened a waitlist for a new retail service that removes corporate markups from the pricing of health supplements and protein powders. The service uses AI agents to automate the sourcing and operational tasks normally managed by brand owners and distributors, leaving members to pay only for raw ingredients, filling, packaging, and shipping. A price comparison shared by Aonic shows its hydration sticks cost $9.35 for 30 units, while the equivalent Liquid I.V. product on Amazon costs $46.86, an 80% difference.

Founding memberships for Aonic Club are priced at $49 for the first year and $149 for each subsequent year to replace the traditional per-product markup. The company aims to apply the efficiency AI has brought to digital labor, such as coding and legal drafting, to the physical goods market to lower the overall cost of living for consumers.
